requirement_text:
As an admin user, I would like to view badge for completed applications.

Change the label to link for completed applications grid
My Idea if when the link is clicked then a new window should open and show their badges
My vision is the badge is like Accredible badge provider
Use any badge provider to show this badge in new window

requirements.text: The system shall display the badge label as a link in the completed applications grid.
The system shall open a new window to display the application badge when the badge link is clicked.
The system shall render the application badge using an Accredible-style badge provider view.

tasks.name: Add ViewBadge action to AdminController, create ViewBadge.cshtml Accredible-style badge provider view, and update Completed Applications grid in Index.cshtml to render badge label as link opening in new window
